name: Backhand blocks in a row
howToMeasure: Your partner, feeder or robot sends medium-fast topspin to your backhand. Count blocks that land. Best of three tries.

name: Forehand loops against a block, in a row
howToMeasure: Loop against a steady block or light topspin feed to your forehand. Count loops that land. Best of three tries.

name: Backhand topspins against backspin
howToMeasure: 10 backspin balls to your backhand. Count the topspins that land.

name: Forehand flicks on the table
howToMeasure: 10 short balls to your forehand. Count the flicks that land.
